items.title: William Russell Interview, 1962-09-04
items.q: I mentioned about Norwood Williams. You might look up some notes on him right now if I can find them.

ctx.x: Chicago. Chicago. Then later he went to Los Angeles and died out there and made some records with Ori, or maybe not records, he made some radio appearances for Orson Welles, which he only really knew Arlene's band, type band he played with, say six or seven pieces for many years. He made them for this group with Mud Carey and Zutty Singleton as the drummer. So I'll hunt up some of those noon notes which are very sketchy too, very unfortunately. Very little is known about his life. I mentioned about Norwood…
